content.short: Populate Bunny Island by collecting, breeding, and genetically modifying digital bunnies.
content.description: Bunny Island aims to be the first completely decentralized breeding/collecting game. You will also be able to modify Bunnies genetically using in-game items. This will happen on-chain, entirely supervised by an uncompromising smart contract written in Plutus and running on the Cardano blockchain. We will feature a new kind of NFT that allows state and meaningful interaction with Plutus smart contracts. Bunny Island aims to be the first completely decentralized breeding/collecting game. You will also be able to modify Bunnies genetically using in-game items.
content.meta: Find out about Bunny Island (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
